Hello Mara, Sarah, John — I want to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). Could you tell me your availability, within 09:00–17:00?

On my side next week is almost full; the windows that are free are:
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Tuesday 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30

If none of those works, say which slots you can make and I will move something. Once I hear back I will book the slot and confirm it here.

Good afternoon — could you send me the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings for next week (Monday November 23 to Friday November 27)? I need to fit a CSE455 staff meeting in and don't want to clash with anything departmental. Thank you. — Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez — John here. My availability next week, 09:00–17:00:

- **Monday 14:00–14:30** — free, works for me.
- **Tuesday 11:00–11:30** — I'm in the reading group until 11:50, so no.
- **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** — free (I have an advisor 1:1 until 15:00 and the study group from 15:30, so the slot just fits).
- **Wednesday 10:00–10:30** — free too.

Monday 14:00–14:30 is my first choice, but any of the three you listed apart from Tuesday 11:00 works. Let me know which one you book and I'll block it.

Hi Professor, all three of your windows are clear for me:
- Monday 14:00–14:30 — free
- Tuesday 11:00–11:30 — free
- Tuesday 15:00–15:30 — free
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — free

Whatever you pick works on my side; the width of the slot is fine too. I'll hold them until you book.

Hi Professor Alvarez, Sarah, John — thanks for the windows.

Straight answer from me: of the slots you listed, **Wednesday 10:00–10:30** works, and so does Monday 14:00–14:30. So I can meet next week if that's what the week needs.

But I'd rather ask for a favour: could we put the staff meeting in the **following week** (Mon Nov 30 – Fri Dec 4) instead? My section of next week's material isn't finished yet — it needs a few more days — and I'd rather bring it to the meeting in a state we can actually look at together than spend the meeting on a half-built draft and then redo the discussion later. If we meet on Nov 30 or Dec 1 I'll have it ready to walk through, and the same 09:00–17:00 windows work for me.

If next week is the only week that works for everyone, I'll take Wednesday 10:00–10:30 and make do — just tell me which you prefer and I'll hold it.

Wednesday 10:00–10:30 works for me too, so either of those two is fine on my side, Mara.

As for the following week (Nov 30 – Dec 4): that part of my calendar isn't filled in yet, so I don't want to promise confidently for it — but nothing there is blocking me that I know of. If the professor prefers to wait a few days for your material, I'm happy to go with it.

Your call, Professor.

Thank you all — and thank you for asking, Mara.

I'd rather not let the term's teaching wait on a moving target, so let's meet in the term **next Wednesday, Nov 25, 10:00–10:30**. That slot is clear on my calendar, on the department's list of gaps, and for all three of you; John, my apology to you and to Mara, it means your first choices don't win.

Mara: Nov 30 or Dec 1 would suit me too, so if your section is in a state you'd like to walk through together, book your own 30 minutes with me in that week when you see the shape of it — that can be a second, focused session on your material, and I'm happy to give it the extra time.

Mara, Sarah, John: it is booked — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30. Please hold it. If anything changes on your side, tell me here today.

Thank you for the schedule, and for the note about the overlapping entries — I saw them and will look into the Seminar/CSE455-lecture/Faculty-meeting pile-up on Monday.

For your records: I have fixed the CSE455 staff meeting for **Wednesday November 25, 10:00–10:30**. It sits in your 12:00–13:30 gap? No — it begins at 10:00, just before the CSE455 office hours you list from 10:30, and Wed 10:00 is free on your sheet, so nothing departmental is displaced. Please add it to the office schedule.

— Professor Alvarez

Understood — **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is held** on my side. Nothing changes on my end today.

And thank you for the second session — I'll take it. I'll book 30 minutes with you in the week of Nov 30 – Dec 1 once I see the shape of my section, so we can go through the material properly rather than around it.

Noted, Professor Alvarez — CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday November 25, 10:00–10:30, recorded on the office schedule.

It is indeed free: the 09:00–10:00 entries (CSE452 lecture, Thesis committee) end at 10:00 and CSE455 office hours start at 10:30, so nothing departmental is displaced.
Booked on my side: Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is on my calendar and held. Nothing on my side changes. See you all then.

Confirmed on my side, Professor — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is held and I've put it in my calendar. Nothing changes on my side. Thanks for sorting it out.

Mara: good news that you get the extra session for your material.
Same here — Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30 is in my calendar and held. See you all then. And thanks, John.
